rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “central” means very important.

example.english: This decision is central to the whole plan.
example.traditional: 呢個決定對成個計劃好重要。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 kyut3 ding6 deoi3 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this instead of 重要 when “central” means decisive or key to the outcome.

example.english: This step is central to the outcome of the match.
example.traditional: 呢一步係成場比賽嘅關鍵。
example.jyutping: nei1 jat1 bou6 hai6 sing4 coeng4 bei2 coi3 ge3 gwaan1 gin6

rows.note: Use this for something physically located in the middle rather than at an edge.

example.english: The table is in the central part of the room.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 baai2 zo2 hai2 fong4 gaan1 zung1 gaan1

rows.note: Use this for a central position or area, especially in more formal or institutional descriptions.

example.english: A statue was placed in the central area of the hall.
example.traditional: 大堂中央擺咗一座雕像。
example.jyutping: daai6 tong4 zung1 joeng1 baai2 zo2 jat1 zo6 diu1 zoeng6
